kind: label audit bundle, NOT a benchmark split: Lyon is a training-only candidate city (#159 decision of 2026-10-06). It is not registered anywhere and nothing scores it as a split.
status: staged, NOT reviewed: no verdicts.json, nothing scored. The plan and pass bar in audit_plan.json are a working draft; 'posted' below pins the version posted on #159, and score refuses any other.

never_train.rule: Every id in ids.txt (the 200 audited panos) and every run pano within 30 m of one (exclude_ids.txt) is held out of every training pool, whatever the audit reads.
never_train.how: haversine on the run's lat/lng, every run pano against every audited pano (lyon_review_159.py stage; exclusion_ids). 6,021 of the run's 174,405 panos, the 200 audited included.
never_train.enforcement: the training-label builder must be passed these lists (#266 requires --benchmark-ids for a city with a benchmark/<city>/ directory); nothing in this repo enforces it on its own

imagery.credit: Each pano is credited by the copyright and license fields of records.jsonl. The review gallery is built with --hide-credit, so the reviewer does not see the producer; the credit stays in the records. stage masks email-shaped tokens in every file it writes; this draw holds none.

run.detection_commit: fd08b8f (plain clone of main, Hyak job 41504145, ckpt-g2, one L40S)
run.detection_border: exclude (production drops peaks within 10 heatmap cells of the seam, sidewalk-auto-labeler#130)
run.archive: makelab2:/projects/makeabilitylab/sidewalk-auto-labeler/runs/lyon/panos/ (all 174,405 native panos, index.csv with sha256 per file)

export.exporter: scripts/export_benchmark.py at sidewalk-auto-labeler f5ddd6d (branch lyon-review-bundle-159, PR 167): stratified sampling by --group-key
export.reproduced: re-run from f5ddd6d into a fresh directory: records.jsonl byte-identical, sample.json identical apart from source_records
export.superseded_draw: a first draw (top 10, group-min 20, records down to 0.30; exporter records sha256 d17d367e...) was replaced on 2026-10-20 after review of PR 264, before anyone reviewed it
export.pixels: --records-only: the panos are copied out of the makelab2 archive, not re-fetched from Panoramax

staged.changes: records.jsonl is byte-identical to the exporter's (no email-shaped token in this draw)
files: nadir_band.json and imagery_manifest.json (once the panos are local)
index.csv and panos/ (git-ignored, travel with the imagery)

posted.note: the version of the plan and sample in force when the review opens; score refuses an audit_plan.json with any other sha256. Amending the plan before the review means a new post and a new pin here.
